_description: Expected results for hardened nginx: Server header 'nginx' must NOT trigger version disclosure. Security headers present must NOT generate missing-header findings.

must_not_detect.rationale: FP regression: 'nginx' (no version) must NOT be flagged as version disclosure. Only 'nginx/1.20.1' format triggers the finding. This was a confirmed historical false positive.
HSTS header is present and valid — must not be reported missing.
CSP frame-ancestors 'none' is present — X-Frame-Options suppression must fire (XFO is the deprecated fallback when CSP frame-ancestors is set).
CSP is present — must not report missing CSP.
